notes.title: 2.1.0 Update Log
notes.content:
Sorry for not updating the game for such a long time. I’ve spent a significant amount of time completely reworking the AI system, restructuring part of the technical framework, and fixing numerous bugs. In the near future, I’ll focus on creating more content. Thank you all for your support!

Updates:
Added the "Mermaid" race tag to Experienced Mermaid.

tags.feature: Added the "Mermaid" race tag to Experienced Mermaid.
